section.title: Tagging uploaded photos
section.scenario: A photo service tags each upload with labels from a vision API. Uploads arrive at about ten a minute.
section.question: Which piece fits this service better, and why?
section.piece_a:
class T
  def go(p)
    r = Api.call(p.u)
    p.update!(t: r.map { |x| x["n"] })
  end
end
section.piece_b:
# Tags a photo with the labels the vision API returns for its image.
class PhotoTagger
  def tag(photo)
    labels = VisionApi.labels_for(photo.url)
    photo.update!(tags: labels.map { |label| label["name"] })
  end
end
